stdout: restart or resume Codex, then trust the three Khala hooks in "Hooks need review"

files..codex/config.toml:
model = "existing"

# Khala MCP server, managed by `khala install codex`
[mcp_servers.khala]
command = "<HOME>/.local/share/khala/npm/bin/khala"
args = ["mcp", "--harness", "codex"]
env = { HOME = "<HOME>", XDG_STATE_HOME = "<HOME>/.local/state" }
